post.description: You have an entity_id from `search` (or a Colorado SOS ID number) and need the current record.

entity_id.description: 11-digit Colorado SOS ID number of a business entity (e.g. 20201707433 for Palantir Technologies Inc.). Trade name and trademark IDs (record_kind other than entity in `search`) are not entities and answer not_found. Pattern: ^[0-9]{11}$.

200.description:
Summary of one Colorado business entity by its 11-digit ID number (the site's BusinessEntityDetail page): name (with the site's status suffix such as ', Dissolved December 2, 2018' when present), status, formation date, form (spelled out, e.g. 'Foreign Corporation'), periodic report month, jurisdiction, principal office street and mailing addresses, registered agent name and addresses. Colorado does not publish officers or directors; the filing history (`filings`) links to the filed documents.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `additional_details` | object | Other label/value rows of the summary page's Details table that are not modelled above (e.g. 'Term of duration', 'Delinquent date'), passed through as displayed so nothing the site shows is dropped. |
| `entity_id` | string | ID number as displayed on the summary page. |
| `filings_url` | string | The entity's 'Filing history and documents' page (session-bound; use `filings`). |
| `form` | string | Entity form as displayed (e.g. 'Foreign Corporation', 'Limited Liability Company'). |
| `formation_date` | string | Formation date, YYYY-MM-DD; null when the page shows none. |
| `jurisdiction` | string | Jurisdiction of formation as displayed (e.g. 'Colorado', 'Delaware'); null when not shown. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `periodic_report_month` | string | Month the periodic (annual) report is due, as displayed (e.g. 'August'); null when the page shows none (dissolved or withdrawn entities). The exact due date is in `filings` ('Periodic report due by'). |
| `principal_office` | object |  |
| `registered_agent` | object | Registered agent as displayed; null when the page has no Registered Agent table (typical for dissolved or withdrawn records). |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `status` | string | Status as displayed (e.g. 'Good Standing', 'Delinquent', 'Voluntarily Dissolved', 'Withdrawn'). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Filing history and documents of one Colorado business entity (the site's BusinessEntityHistory page), one page of about 20 rows: event, date filed, date posted, effective date and time, document number with its PDF link (ViewImage.do), and comment. 'Periodic Report due' rows carry the due date in the comment; it is parsed into periodic_report_due, and the latest one on the page into latest_periodic_report_due. Officers are not part of Colorado filings; the PDFs name only the individual causing delivery.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `filings` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | Comment as displayed (e.g. 'Periodic report due by: 10/31/2026', 'Registered Agent Address Change'); null when blank. |
| `date_filed` | string |  |
| `date_posted` | string |  |
| `document_id` | string | 11-digit document number; null for rows without a document (e.g. 'Periodic Report due'). |
| `document_url` | string | PDF of the filed document (ViewImage.do), fetchable without a session. |
| `effective_at` | string | Effective date and time as displayed by the site (Mountain Time, no zone), YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM; date only when the site shows no time. |
| `event` | string | Event as displayed (e.g. 'Report', 'Periodic Report due', 'Statement of Change', 'Articles of Incorporation'). |
| `periodic_report_due` | string | Due date parsed from the comment: 'Periodic report due by: MM/DD/YYYY' on current 'Periodic Report due' rows, or 'annual/periodic report due: <date>' on pre-2012 postcard-notification rows; null for other rows. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: Start here to find the 11-digit entity_id for `entity` and `filings`.

name.description: Business name, trade name or trademark text. The site matches every record whose name has a word starting with this text (a multi-word text as a phrase), case-insensitive, and caps the result set at a few hundred records: `Animal Clinic` (about 330 rows) passes, common words such as `Denver`, `Veterinary` or `Animal Hospital` exceed the cap and fail with invalid_input (issue code too_many_matches). There is no status, city, county or address filter to narrow with; add a distinguishing word of the name instead.

page.description:
1-based results page (about 20 rows per page). Each page costs a fresh search session on the site.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 200; default 1.

200.description:
Search the Colorado Secretary of State business database by business name, trade name or trademark text (the site's basic search: case-insensitive, matching every record whose name has a word starting with the text, a multi-word text as a phrase; `Redmond` finds `Hendon & Redmond, Inc.`). Returns the results table as displayed: one row per record event (an entity can appear more than once, e.g. its formation document and a later delinquency event), with the 11-digit ID number, document number, name, event, status, form code and formation date, about 20 rows per page. The site offers no status, city, county or address filter (its Advanced Search is reCAPTCHA-gated and has none either) and refuses result sets above a few hundred records, so a sector-wide sweep by a common word (`Veterinary`, `Animal Hospital`) fails with invalid_input: search narrower names and resolve status and addresses per ID with `entity`. An 11-digit ID or document number is a single-record lookup: pass it to `entity` instead.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `document_id` | string | 11-digit document number of the filing this row describes; null for batch events (e.g. delinquency) that have no document. |
| `entity_id` | string | 11-digit ID number (masterFileId); the key for `entity` and `filings`. For trade names it is the trade name record's ID. |
| `event` | string | Event as displayed (e.g. 'Articles of Incorporation', 'Statement of Foreign Entity Authority/ Entity Name', 'Batch Event'). |
| `form` | string | Form code as displayed in the results table (DPC, DLLC, FPC, FLLC, Individual, ...); null when the cell is blank. |
| `formation_date` | string | Formation date, YYYY-MM-DD; null when blank. |
| `name` | string | Name as displayed; the site appends status notes such as ', Dissolved December 2, 2018' or ', Delinquent May 1, 2025'. |
| `record_kind` | string | Derived from the record link: BusinessEntityDetail.do is an entity, TradeNameSummary.do a trade name, a Trademark*.do page a trademark; anything else is other. |
| `source_url` | string | The record's page on www.sos.state.co.us as linked from the results table. |
| `status` | string | Status as displayed (e.g. 'Good Standing', 'Delinquent', 'Voluntarily Dissolved', 'Name Changed'). |
